name: Kenta Iwamoto Foot Sweep System
description: Kenta Iwamoto’s Samurai Foot Sweeps & Leg Trips covers kouchi and kosoto situations, grip fighting, over-under throws and shot-defense topics.
summary: Foot sweeps, clinch throws and responses to shots within a standing grappling course.
overview: Samurai Foot Sweeps & Leg Trips develops Kenta Iwamoto’s standing attacks from kouchi and kosoto into grip fighting and clinch throws. The course also covers shot defense, extending its scope beyond foot sweeps. It fits grapplers interested in attacks from upright ties and over-under exchanges.

related_content.name: Jimmy Sheptock Single Leg System

guide.display_title: Kenta Iwamoto: Foot Sweeps and Leg Trips

fits: You want standing attacks built around foot sweeps and clinch trips.
You want grip-fighting and shot-defense material alongside throws.

includes: Kouchi and kosoto mechanics and attacking situations.
Grip fighting, over-under throws and overhook or underhook clinches.
limits: The five parts focus on standing exchanges, without a ground-control or submission curriculum.
